title: IdentityConfig
description: The identity providers whose access tokens the control plane accepts, loaded from the file DAC_IDENTITY_CONFIG_FILE names: Surface API callers (ADR-0007) and provider adapters' client-credentials tokens (ADR-0008). An issuer listed in both must use a different audience in each; the Go contract enforces that.

adapter_issuers.description: Issuers of adapter client-credentials tokens; the audience names the adapter endpoint. Absent means no adapter can connect.

audience.description: The identifier this API expects in the aud claim.

algorithms.description: Asymmetric JWS algorithms this issuer is pinned to; never taken from the access token itself.

max_token_lifetime_seconds.description: The longest exp minus iat accepted.

clock_skew_seconds.description: Leeway for exp, nbf and iat. Defaults to 30.

require_access_token_type.description: Require the at+jwt type (RFC 9068). Defaults to true; false only for an issuer that cannot type its access tokens, whose audience must then be issued for this API alone.

development.description: Marks a test issuer of the development profile (ADR-0009). A production deployment refuses a configuration that trusts one.
